# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Yard families advertise free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]PREFAB BUNK TO LET[/bold], shaded side of the row, new tape on every seam. Shares a water reclaimer with two quiet families. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], any roof that keeps the sand out. Will patch, seal and sweep in place of rent. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]YARD HANDS WANTED[/bold] for the long shift. Steady pay, hard work, no questions about the paperwork. - [bold]SEAL CREW[/bold] needed to reseal prefabs after the dust blows through. Bring your own tape.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]COOLING VESTS[/bold], refilled and tested. Will trade for water chits or filter cartridges. - [bold]BLACKOUT CURTAINS[/bold], made from old transport blankets. Real sleep in a place with no night.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: a miner's lamp and a lunch tin on the path toward the podlocks. Do not go looking past the locks. Leave them at the press office if they turn up.
## Notices - Families from the transport meet on the first rest day of every month to read the names of those we have lost since the landing. All are welcome.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
